name: task_assign
description: Assign (or rework) one worker's slice of the goal: sets its file boundary and acceptance bar and delivers the task card. The first dispatch keeps the round; every re-dispatch is rework and bumps the round, refused past max_rounds.

worker.description: Worker session id to assign (one id from task_start).

scope_files.description: File boundary: the only files this worker may touch (at least one).

acceptance.description: Acceptance bar the worker's report must clear (e.g. 'login test passes').
